ora·ïto — projects — Monroe

Monroe

Category Lighting
Brand Artemide
Collection Artemide
Year 2007

Monroe is a table lamp, made of steel and fiberglass, which thanks to the two pivots located on the base and at the level of the diffuser can rotate 360° and thus guarantee a wide radius of orientation of the light on the work surface.
